description:
Use this when the user asks for their own matches: open contracts for their business. It needs a linked MatchAwards account and uses that account's NAICS codes and state; without a linked account it asks the user to link one.

Options: type (federal or state), ignore_state (true: every state), only_my_set_aside (true: only notices set aside for the account's set-aside; by default open competitions are included too), limit (1 to 50, default 20). If has_more is true, call again with cursor=next_cursor and the same options.

Print each result's url, and sam_url for federal notices, as markdown links.

Do not use for searches with the user's own filters (search_contracts) or for grants (search_grants).

When you are done searching, call show_results once with the best ids; it shows them as a card the user can pick from.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous response. Pass it with the same filters to get the next page.
cursor.title: Cursor

ignore_state.description: true: search every state, not only the profile's.
ignore_state.title: Ignore State

limit.description: Number of results to return, 1 to 50.
limit.title: Limit

only_my_set_aside.description: true: only notices set aside for the profile's set-aside.
only_my_set_aside.title: Only My Set Aside

type.description: Narrow to federal or to state contracts. Leave empty for both.
type.title: Type

name: my_matches

OpportunityRow.description: One search result. Jobs fill title, agency (the employer), state, city, posted_at and url only.

ai_matched_naics.description: Only when you filtered by naics: requested codes this contract notice matched only because MatchAwards' AI suggested them, not its own codes. Call such a match AI-suggested.
ai_matched_naics.title: Ai Matched Naics

id.description: Pass to get_opportunity for the description and contacts.
id.title: Id

matched_naics.description: Only when you filtered by naics: the requested codes this record carries: its own code (in naics) or, for a grant or job, another code of its program or occupation.
matched_naics.title: Matched Naics

naics.description: On state notices (type state) the naics code itself is AI-assigned.

no_fixed_deadline.description: true: the deadline is a placeholder date.
no_fixed_deadline.title: No Fixed Deadline

sam_url.description: The SAM.gov notice (federal only). Show it as a markdown link.
sam_url.title: Sam Url

url.description: The posting on matchawards.com. Show it as a markdown link.
url.title: Url

OpportunityRow.title: OpportunityRow

ProfileUsed.description: The filters my_matches took from the linked account's MatchAwards profile.

naics.description: The profile's NAICS codes that were searched; [] when it has none.
naics.title: Naics

set_aside.description: The profile's set-aside code, or null when it has none.
set_aside.title: Set Aside

set_aside_applied.description: true: only notices set aside for it were searched (only_my_set_aside); false: notices open to all firms are included.
set_aside_applied.title: Set Aside Applied

set_aside_name.description: The set-aside's name (e.g. Total Small Business), or null.
set_aside_name.title: Set Aside Name

state.description: The profile's state, or null when it has none or ignore_state was set.
state.title: State

ProfileUsed.title: ProfileUsed

as_of.description: When the API generated the results (ISO time).
as_of.title: As Of

has_more.description: true: call again with cursor=next_cursor and the same filters.
has_more.title: Has More

settings_url.description: Set when the profile has no NAICS codes: the match settings page on matchawards.com where the user adds them. Show it as a markdown link.
settings_url.title: Settings Url

warning.description: Set when paging stopped early; the results so far are still valid.
warning.title: Warning

title: My matches
